questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Semiconductor Diodes, Zener Diodes and Rectifier/Clipping Circuits
questions.text: Explain PN Junction Diode: Forward and Reverse bias V-I characteristics, Diode current equation ($I = I_0 (e^{V / \eta V_T} - 1)$), Dynamic resistance, and Diffusion vs Transition capacitance. Explain Zener Diode and Zener Voltage Regulator circuit.

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Semiconductor Diodes, Zener Diodes and Rectifier/Clipping Circuits
questions.text: Explain Rectifiers: Center-Tapped Full-Wave Rectifier vs Bridge Rectifier. Derive expressions for DC output voltage ($V_{dc} = \frac{2 V_m}{\pi}$), RMS current, Ripple Factor ($\gamma = 0.482$), and Rectification Efficiency ($\eta = 81.2\%$). Explain Capacitor Filter ($C$-filter).

Explain Bipolar Junction Transistor (BJT): Input and Output characteristics in Common Emitter (CE), Common Base (CB), and Common Collector (CC) configurations. Derive relation $\beta = \frac{\alpha}{1 - \alpha}$ and explain Early Effect (Base Width Modulation).

Explain BJT Biasing: Fixed Bias, Collector-to-Base Bias, and Voltage Divider (Self) Bias. Derive Stability Factor $S = \frac{\partial I_C}{\partial I_{CO}}$ for voltage divider bias and draw DC Load Line and Q-point.

Explain Field Effect Transistors (FET): Construction and characteristics of JFET (Shockley's equation: $I_D = I_{DSS}(1 - \frac{V_{GS}}{V_P})^2$) and MOSFET (Depletion MOSFET vs Enhancement MOSFET). Compare BJT vs FET.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Feedback Amplifiers and Sinusoidal Oscillators
questions.text: Explain Small-Signal Low Frequency BJT Amplifier Analysis using $h$-parameter model ($h_{ie}, h_{re}, h_{fe}, h_{oe}$) and $r_e$ model. Calculate Voltage Gain ($A_v$), Current Gain ($A_i$), Input Impedance ($Z_{in}$), and Output Impedance ($Z_{out}$) for a CE amplifier.
